blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-19. Census chainShares are absent; measured supplies total 539,605,535.58 wiTRY: Ethereum 269,825,447.4798 (50.0042%, block 26224776), MegaETH 269,779,143.0983 (49.9956%, block 29593655), Robinhood 945.0067 (0.0002%, block 92398927). Ethereum and MegaETH are material. The Ethereum token 0xe346c29b5b60ef870b9724c57ccfbbc631e47dee is the verified StakediTryCrosschain wrapper (StakediTry base). owner() returned 0x15BF1AC31c5b8c0E0960D656de02ba5593b19C47, which is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and whose owner() is the Brix Safe 0x7aC3bB10225a4eF27134bcF54454d545A1738662. hasRole(BLACKLIST_MANAGER_ROLE, 0x7aC3...) returned true. The verified implementation's addToBlacklist grants FULL_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE; _beforeTokenTransfer reverts for any transfer from or to a FULL_RESTRICTED holder, maxWithdraw/maxRedeem return 0 for them, and redistributeLockedAmount burns the restricted holder's balance and mints it to a target under DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. An active non-zero blacklist manager and an active admin forced-transfer path therefore exist on both material deployments. The underlying iTRY (0xb492b4...) separately exposes BLACKLISTED role and redistribution. Reserve test: the 100% wiTRY claim on iTRY/fund shares terminates in issuer control and would satisfy upstream, but direct Yes outranks it.
